payout_quote: Receive a $250 reward when you open a new primary free checking account and perform the following actions within the first 90 days after account opening: sign up for eStatements, make monthly deposits totaling $500 or more per month for three consecutive months, and conduct 10 or more qualifying debit card transactions per month for three consecutive months.
steps: Open a new primary free checking account at Greater Texas Credit Union, presenting promo code CHECKING250 at account opening (online or in person)

Within the first 90 days: sign up for eStatements; make monthly deposits totaling $500 or more for three consecutive months; conduct 10 or more qualifying debit card purchases per month for three consecutive months
Keep the account open; the $250 reward is automatically deposited into the checking account within 60 days of meeting the qualification criteria
catches: Offer valid through September 30, 2026 - the account must be opened by that date (time-sensitive)
Multi-month commitment: three consecutive months each of $500+ in deposits AND 10+ debit card purchases
Qualifying transactions are debit card purchases only - ATM withdrawals/deposits and payments via Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, etc. do not count
Promo code CHECKING250 must be presented at the time of account opening
New primary checking accounts only; one $250 offer per individual; must be 18 years or older
Reward is deposited within 60 days after meeting criteria - payout can be months after opening
biggest_catch: The offer window closes September 30, 2026, and you must sustain three straight months of $500+ monthly deposits plus 10+ debit purchases each month before the $250 pays out.
eligibility: 18+; new primary free checking accounts at Greater Texas Credit Union (and Aggieland Credit Union branding under gtfcu.org); one $250 offer per individual; promo code CHECKING250 at opening.
timing: Account must be opened by 9/30/2026; actions within first 90 days; reward paid within 60 days of meeting criteria.
